metadata.title: Market policy evolution under frozen settlement semantics
metadata.claim_boundary: evolvability-only; no performance or architecture ranking

research_question: When pricing, fee, or matching policy changes while the shared settlement protocol remains fixed, which deployment units, privileged actions, migrations, recovery blocks, and setup fees change in each architecture?

policy_variants.matching_rule: first eligible order by canonical arrival sequence
first eligible order by canonical arrival sequence
first eligible order by canonical arrival sequence

policy_variants.pricing_rule: buyer offers are base_price, floor(base_price * 10500 / 10000), and floor(base_price * 11000 / 10000)
policy_variants.matching_rule: highest canonical gross_price; ties broken by canonical arrival sequence

controls.policy_dimension_change_rule: exactly one of pricing, fee, or matching differs from control
controls.comparison_unit: same baseline, operation, and policy dimension

execution_order.randomization: deterministic permutation within each baseline and operation
execution_order.reset: fresh isolated fixture before each chain repetition
execution_order.variant_identity: independent clean commit and manifest for every non-control baseline variant

actor_and_object_derivation.market_accounts: derive and record AccountId32 values from //R2//X1//Market//<slot> under sr25519-substrate-v1
actor_and_object_derivation.buyer_accounts: derive and record AccountId32 values from //R2//X1//Buyer//<slot>; matching uses three distinct buyers
actor_and_object_derivation.funding: OWNER funds derived accounts to the same frozen target balance before the fixture anchor
actor_and_object_derivation.object_ids: derive distinct operation and repetition scoped IDs from the workload seed and record the canonical inputs in preflight

expected_result_rules: The changed policy must produce the configured canonical order fields without changing settlement protocol v1.
Every applicable I1-I10 predicate must pass after the policy change.
All structural and setup counts must be derived from captured diffs, transactions, events, and migration inventories rather than author labels.
The experiment answers evolvability only; latency or per-order cost must not be used to rank B1, B2, and G3.
stop_gates: E0 is not PASS for a variant commit
more than one policy dimension changes
settlement protocol, canonical schema, authority boundary, or I1-I10 semantics change
a structural or setup metric lacks its captured source
a required common capability is missing
